candidates.source_name: Ministerstvo financí ČR — Finanční trh: Bankovnictví a dohled (odbor Finanční trhy)
candidates.why_relevant: MF ČR is the statute-level author for banking and payments law in CZ. This section hosts právní rámce, aktuality and consultation announcements for the banking/supervision agenda before anything reaches ČNB implementation.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled HTML crawl of the section index + aktuality subpages; diff on new items; follow PDF attachments under /assets/attachments/.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from MF press releases
queries_used: mf.gov.cz finanční trh legislativa připravované právní předpisy bankovnictví aktuality

candidates.source_name: MF ČR — Platební služby a vypořádání obchodů (aktuality / konzultace)
candidates.why_relevant: The single most on-point MF page for zákon o platebním styku (370/2017 Sb.) amendments, PSD/PSR-related adaptation drafts and public consultations. Historic pattern shows consultation notices posted here with comment deadlines and a contact mailbox.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the /aktuality/<year>/ subtree; extract title, publication date, comment deadline (lhůta), and attached PDFs (návrh zákona, důvodová zpráva).
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query, snowballed from MF aktuality URL pattern
queries_used: Ministerstvo financí novela zákona o platebním styku návrh

candidates.source_name: MF ČR — Tiskové zprávy (press releases)
candidates.why_relevant: Fastest-signalling MF channel: announces government approval of bills, submission to the Chamber of Deputies, and policy intent, usually the same day. Good early-warning trigger for deeper eKLEP/PSP lookups.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily crawl of the year-indexed listing; keyword filter on platební styk, banky, spořitelní, finanční trh, digitalizace.
queries_used: Ministerstvo financí novela zákona o platebním styku návrh

candidates.source_name: MF ČR — Zpravodaj MF (monthly ministry bulletin)
candidates.why_relevant: Monthly consolidated digest of MF activity including legislative work; useful as a low-noise backstop that catches items missed between crawls.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly fetch of the current issue page/PDF.
queries_used: Ministerstvo financí veřejné konzultace finanční trh materiál k připomínkám 2026

candidates.source_name: MF ČR — Zpráva o vývoji finančního trhu (annual financial market report)
candidates.why_relevant: Annual MF report includes a dedicated chapter on national and EU legislative activity in the financial market — an authoritative retrospective index of what changed and what is pending; useful for backfilling a legislative timeline.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF download and section extraction (legislativní aktivity).
queries_used: mf.gov.cz finanční trh legislativa připravované právní předpisy bankovnictví aktuality

candidates.source_name: VeKLEP — veřejná elektronická knihovna legislativního procesu (ODok portál)
candidates.why_relevant: The public face of eKLEP: full text of draft laws, důvodové zprávy, RIA, comment-procedure status and dates, per-material lifecycle. This is the canonical place where an MF banking/payments bill first becomes publicly readable, months before Parliament.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the materials listing; filter by předkladatel = Ministerstvo financí and title keywords; store PID (e.g. KORNxxxx) as the stable key; download attached DOCX/PDF parts.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball into material detail URLs
queries_used: eKLEP ODok meziresortní připomínkové řízení materiál

candidates.source_name: ODok — VeKLEP novinky v připomínkovém řízení (new materials in comment procedure)
candidates.why_relevant: Rolling list of materials that have just entered meziresortní připomínkové řízení, with comment deadlines. The single best trigger feed for 'a new banking/payments bill just opened for comment'.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily poll; keyword filter (platební, banka, spořitelní, úvěr, finanční trh, digitalizace financí, AML); emit alert with deadline date.
queries_used: eKLEP ODok meziresortní připomínkové řízení materiál

candidates.source_name: Vláda ČR — ODok / informační systém oběhu dokumentů (explainer + entry point)
candidates.why_relevant: Official description of how eKLEP/ODok works, which document types exist and what the public part exposes — needed to build a correct parser and to interpret status codes and stages.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read; re-check annually for process changes.

candidates.source_name: Vláda ČR — Plán legislativních prací vlády / Výhled legislativních prací
candidates.why_relevant: Government's own forward calendar of legislative tasks, naming the responsible ministry and the target month of submission. Gives 6-24 months of advance visibility on planned banking/payments statutes and EU transposition obligations.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch the annual plan PDF (annex 1) plus the multi-year výhled (annex 2); parse the table rows for MF-owned tasks.
queries_used: Plán legislativních prací vlády 2026 vláda.gov.cz dokumenty

candidates.source_name: Vláda ČR — Výsledky jednání vlády / program schůze vlády
candidates.why_relevant: Per-meeting record of which bills the government approved and with what modifications — the gate between the comment procedure and Parliament. Dated, hard evidence of a bill advancing.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of 'Výsledky jednání vlády <date>' items; keyword filter; cross-link to VeKLEP PID.
queries_used: Plán legislativních prací vlády 2026 vláda.gov.cz dokumenty

candidates.source_name: Poslanecká sněmovna PČR — Sněmovní tisky (bill database + historie tisku)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative parliamentary tracking: every bill gets a tisk number with full document set (návrh, důvodová zpráva, pozměňovací návrhy, stanovisko vlády) and a dated stage-by-stage 'historie' page. This is where reading dates, committee referrals and votes become predictable.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query the sntisk.sqw search form by keyword per volební období; then poll historie.sqw?o=<term>&T=<tisk> for stage changes; stable URL scheme makes diffing easy.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball into concrete tisk pages

candidates.source_name: Poslanecká sněmovna — schůze, pořad a stav projednávání (session agendas)
candidates.why_relevant: Shows the agenda of each plenary sitting and the live processing state of each item — the practical way to anticipate when a payments/banking bill will actually be debated.

candidates.source_name: Senát PČR — senátní tisky, legislativní proces a historie tisku
candidates.why_relevant: Second chamber stage: covers the 30-day window where a financial-market bill can be returned with amendments or vetoed, plus committee opinions. Necessary to date účinnost accurately.

candidates.why_relevant: Legally binding electronic collection of laws since 1 Jan 2024; gives the final promulgated text, the částka number, and — critically — the účinnost (entry-into-force) dates of banking/payments amendments, with consolidated versions.

candidates.source_name: ISAP — Informační systém pro aproximaci práva (Úřad vlády)
candidates.why_relevant: Government database tracking EU acts from adoption through Czech implementation, including transposition deadlines, compatibility assessments and which national bill implements which directive. candidates.source_name: Hospodářská komora ČR — Připomínkované legislativní materiály
candidates.why_relevant: HK ČR is a mandatory comment body and republishes each material entering the comment procedure with its own numbering (e.g. 66/25) and an explicit deadline 'T:dd.mm.yyyy'. Far easier to monitor than eKLEP itself and it surfaces business-side objections.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll /pripominkovane-materialy/ with tag filters; parse the T: deadline out of the title; link back to the eKLEP material.

negative_findings.description: No Czech-language MF ČR page announcing a concrete PSD3/PSR transposition draft or consultation was located, despite the EU texts reportedly being agreed and published. English-language search returned only international law-firm commentary, and Czech search returned only older payments-act amendments (2012, 2016, 2019, 2021).
negative_findings.result_summary: PSD3/PSR CZ transposition work appears not yet publicly visible on MF channels as of this scouting pass, or it is filed under an omnibus 'změna některých zákonů v oblasti finančního trhu' title that keyword search did not surface.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's core early-warning promise is seeing payments statute change months ahead; if the PSD3 vehicle is invisible to keyword search, monitoring must be structural (poll all MF-authored VeKLEP materials) rather than keyword-driven.

negative_findings.description: No documented public API or open-data dump for VeKLEP/eKLEP legislative materials was found; open-data/API documentation located covers e-Sbírka and e-Legislativa (Ministry of Interior), not the ODok comment-procedure system.
negative_findings.result_summary: eKLEP/VeKLEP will likely need HTML scraping keyed on the PID identifier; e-Sbírka has proper APIs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Determines collection engineering cost and fragility for the single highest-value source in this cell.

negative_findings.description: Czech government sites are mid-migration across parallel domains: mfcr.cz vs mf.gov.cz, apps.odok.cz vs odok.gov.cz, isap.vlada.cz vs isap.gov.cz, vlada.cz vs vlada.gov.cz. Both variants currently appear in search results for the same content.
negative_findings.result_summary: Multiple live aliases per source; URL stability cannot be assumed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Naive liveness checks and stored URLs will rot; the collector should canonicalise to the .gov.cz variants and tolerate redirects rather than marking sources dead.

negative_findings.description: MF ČR, ODok/VeKLEP, PSP.cz, Senát and e-Sbírka publish legislative material essentially only in Czech; no equivalent English legislative pipeline feed was found. English-language searching returned only private law-firm and consultancy commentary.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-only monitoring of this cell is not viable.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms Czech-language NLP/keyword lists are a hard requirement for A3 coverage rather than a nice-to-have.

negative_findings.description: No candidate URL in this slice was fetched-and-confirmed by this agent; all were derived from search-engine result listings and their titles/snippets.
negative_findings.result_summary: All URLs are provided as hypotheses for the deterministic liveness pass, not as verified endpoints.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents downstream over-trust; ISAP (Lotus Domino) and senat.cz (xqw/xervlet) in particular use fragile URL schemes likely to require session handling.

coverage_gaps.description: Comment-procedure OUTPUT (vypořádání připomínek — who objected and how MF resolved it) was not located as a separately monitorable feed; it is normally an annex inside the government-meeting material rather than an indexed document.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each tracked PID, harvest the 'vypořádání připomínek' annex from the VeKLEP material at the government-submission stage; this is where ČNB, ČBA and MPO positions become visible.

coverage_gaps.description: Industry comment bodies specific to banking/payments (Česká bankovní asociace, ČLFA, ČNB as připomínkové místo, Úřad pro ochranu osobních údajů) were not scouted in this cell — only the cross-sector Hospodářská komora was found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a targeted pass on cba.cz / clfa.cz stanoviska and pripomínky to legislative drafts; coordinate with the supervisor-focused cell to avoid duplication.

coverage_gaps.description: No structured alerting mechanism (RSS/Atom/email subscription) was confirmed for any of the primary state sources; monitoring design currently assumes polling.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe each domain for /rss, /feed, sitemap.xml and any 'odběr novinek' subscription form during the verification pass; fall back to daily diffing where absent.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed crosswalk between the three identifier systems in this pipeline: eKLEP PID (KORNxxxxxxx), sněmovní tisk number + volební období, and the final Sbírka zákonů number.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build and maintain a join table per bill; MF press releases and the government-meeting outcomes are the practical bridging documents.

coverage_gaps.description: Deposit insurance / resolution (zákon o bankách, Garanční systém finančního trhu), AML (zákon č. 253/2008 Sb., new Finanční analytický úřad package spotted in HK ČR listings) and the 'digitalizace finančního trhu' (DORA/MiCA) vehicle were only touched incidentally.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the keyword watchlist beyond 'platební styk' to: zákon o bankách, spořitelní a úvěrní družstva, ozdravné postupy a řešení krize, Finanční analytický úřad, digitalizace finančního trhu, ekonomická ochrana státu.

brief: Statute-level banking and payments change in the Czech Republic moves along a fully public, well-instrumented executive-to-legislature chain: MF ČR announces the draft and its consultation on its finanční trh sections, the full text plus důvodová zpráva and RIA appear in VeKLEP/eKLEP with a hard comment deadline, the government approves it at a dated jednání vlády, it becomes a numbered sněmovní tisk on PSP.cz (with a stage-by-stage historie page), passes the Senát, and is promulgated in e-Sbírka with an explicit účinnost date. Every stage is free, open and in Czech only — English-language coverage exists solely as private law-firm commentary, so Czech-language keyword lists are mandatory rather than optional. The highest-leverage monitoring points are the ODok comment-procedure novelties feed and the government's Plán legislativních prací (6-24 months of forward visibility), with Hospodářská komora's připomínkované materiály as an easier-to-parse mirror carrying explicit deadlines. Main engineering caveats: parallel legacy/new domains (mfcr.cz vs mf.gov.cz, apps.odok.cz vs odok.gov.cz), no confirmed API for eKLEP (unlike e-Sbírka, which has one), and no ready crosswalk between eKLEP PID, sněmovní tisk number and final Sbírka number.
